chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Hadeed ibn Hakim, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Fear Allah and maintain your Religion with devoutness (al-wara').'

key_terms.الْوَرَعِ: Devoutness / Scrupulousness / Piety in avoiding doubtful matters

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to maintain one's religion with al-wara' according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links taqwa directly to al-wara', emphasizing that true piety requires rigorous caution in avoiding not only clear sins but also doubtful matters (shubuhat). This concept is foundational in Shia jurisprudence, serving as the practical mechanism for safeguarding the soul from spiritual corruption and ensuring the authenticity of one's worship.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Hadeed Bin Hakeem who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Fear Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and maintain your Religion with the devoutness’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al- Hassan ibn Mahbub from Hadid ibn Hakim who has said the following:
“I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘Be pious before Allah and protect your religion by means of restraint from worldly matters (sins).’”
